title: Event log record (one JSON object per JSONL line, evtx_parse.py output)

source_file.description: basename of the parsed XML export file

channel.description: System/Channel, e.g. Security, System, Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational

provider.description: System/Provider@Name (canonical provider name, not the friendly GUI name)

level.description: 0 LogAlways, 1 Critical, 2 Error, 3 Warning, 4 Information, 5 Verbose

keywords.description: raw Keywords text as it appears in XML (hex string such as 0x8020000000000000)

time_created.description: TimeCreated/@SystemTime normalized to microsecond ISO 8601 UTC (7th 100-ns digit dropped); null if absent/unparseable

record_id.description: per-channel EventRecordID; restarts low after a log clear

security_user_id.description: System/Security/@UserID — account context that emitted the event

execution_process_id.description: logging thread's PID (hex in XML, decoded here) — NOT the subject process

event_data.description: named <Data Name=...> values in document order; unnamed entries keyed Data[<index>]; duplicate names suffixed #2, #3, ...; <Binary> payloads keyed 'Binary' (raw hex string as stored)

user_data.description: provider-specific nested <UserData> XML flattened to an object; XML attributes keyed @name; repeated elements become arrays

raw_xml.description: only present with --raw; the event re-serialized by the parser (namespace prefixes may be rewritten, whitespace normalized), capped at 65536 characters
